requires.degrade: Without node, setup's toolchain check cannot run, and the chart launcher needs Bun or Deno in its place (or the script_runtime option naming one).

Without Java at the java.min_version setting or later, TLC cannot run, so /formal-verification:chart stops before it checks a spec. The java option can name a binary off PATH. The plugin never installs Java.

Without the TLC jar, /formal-verification:chart stops before it checks a spec. This row cannot see the jar that setup installs in the plugin data directory or the one the model_checker_jar option names, so it warns even when the jar is present; the model-checker row of /formal-verification:setup check decides.
Without the renderer, /formal-verification:chart still writes chart.mmd and the report; it cannot write an SVG image of the chart.
